With data and advanced analytics at the center of our people strategy, we are seeking an analytically driven People Analytics professional to join our People Analytics team. In this role, you will develop, optimize, and enhance data-driven insights across the employee lifecycle.

You will partner closely with stakeholders across HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, IT, and Legal to deliver analytics that support strategic workforce planning, improve employee experiences, and enable informed business decisions.
You will apply advanced analytics, predictive modeling, statistical techniques, and emerging AI capabilities to ¯solve complex workforce challenges. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys transforming data into actionable insights, collaborating across functions, and continuously advancing modern analytics practices within HR.

People Analytics & Insights
Analyze and report on the employee lifecycle—from hiring and onboarding through development and exit—by developing dashboards and reports that provide insights into hiring, attrition, engagement, performance, promotions, compensation, headcount, and organizational health.
Partner with People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Finance, and other Centers of Excellence to deliver analytics supporting quarterly business reviews, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.
Design scalable reporting solutions and self-service dashboards that improve access to trusted workforce insights.
Collaborate with HR Technology and data teams to ensure data quality, governance, and consistency across people data platforms.
Translate business questions into analytical approaches and communicate findings through compelling visualizations and executive-ready presentations.
Advanced People Analytics
Design, develop, and maintain predictive analytics models that help identify workforce trends, risks, and opportunities.
Apply advanced statistical techniques, including regression analysis, clustering, forecasting, survival analysis, and segmentation, to solve business problems.

AI & Natural Language Processing (NLP)

Use topic modeling, sentiment analysis, and text analytics to identify emerging themes and actionable insights.
Explore and prototype Generative AI use cases that automate narrative reporting, summarize workforce trends, and enhance the delivery of people insights.
Partner with HR Technology and analytics teams to evaluate AI-enabled solutions that improve reporting efficiency and decision support while maintaining appropriate governance and data privacy standards.

Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex findings into clear business recommendations.
Excellent data visualization and storytelling skills tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.

Relay is a parcel delivery network. Every night, parcels from online retailers arrive at our sort centres, are sorted into delivery routes, and go out the next day with couriers. Two things have to go right for that to work.
Routing is the planning side: software that decides, before parcels have even arrived, which ones to expect, how to group them into routes, and how to make those routes efficient for couriers to drive. Sortation is the physical side: warehouse teams and sorting robots turning a building full of parcels into neatly separated routes, thousands of times a night.
The two are tightly coupled. If the plan expects a parcel that never arrives, a courier's route has a hole in it. If the warehouse sorts a parcel the plan didn't expect, it has nowhere to go. This role owns the analytics across both: spotting when either side is off, working out why, and building the case for what to change.
Your work splits between a daily operational rhythm (is the network healthy this morning, and if not, why) and deeper investigations (what is driving cost, where is the plan falling short of what's possible, what should we change). Your analysis won't sit in a dashboard waiting to be discovered - it will change which parcels get planned for, how warehouse shifts are scheduled, and where the operation focuses its improvement efforts.
Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 data engineers, analysts, and data scientists, with analysts embedded into teams across the business. You will sit with the Routing & Sortation teams but report into the central data team, working daily with software engineers, warehouse operations, commercial, and finance.

Routing
Monitor the health of each night's route plans: how many parcels each route carries (planned vs what actually happened), how far couriers travel before their first delivery, and the routes no courier should ever be handed - a single parcel stranded miles from every other stop, or one route torn between two towns - and diagnose the cause when any of it moves
Track how well we predict which parcels will arrive each night: when expected parcels don't show up, or unexpected ones do, work out whether the cause was the retailer's data, a warehouse error, or timing, and improve the prediction rules client by client
Act on what you find: flag issues to warehouse managers and retailer-facing teams, and correct the plan when a retailer's parcels arrive outside the normal flow
Monitor the route optimisation engine itself and flag regressions when the software or its inputs change
Quantify how route design affects courier productivity: deliveries per hour, stops per route, distance between drops - and how far our actual routes sit from the best theoretically possible
Build the reporting that diagnoses the middle leg of the network: the van journeys that move sorted parcels from sort centres out to local pick-up points where couriers collect them
Partner with the engineers who build the routing systems to test and validate changes
Sortation
Investigate cost per parcel: where are we spending too much, where are savings available, and what's driving the variance
Track warehouse operative performance: throughput, accuracy, shift utilisation, and the balance between permanent and agency labour
Monitor sorting robot efficiency and capacity: what volumes can they sustain, where are the bottlenecks, how do they compare to manual sorting
Build models to predict how many operatives each shift needs, and help automate workforce planning around the best performers
Compare the parcel volumes retailers actually send us against what they told us to expect, and find where the gaps come from
Define KPIs and build dashboards that make routing and sortation performance transparent to operations and leadership
Work with commercial teams to set volume limits and delivery timings that balance growth with operational stability

Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

The Marketing & Growth team is one of the largest and most dynamic at Fever, playing a central role in driving visibility, engagement, and business impact across the company. We work closely with nearly every department, combining strategy, creativity, and data to connect millions of people with unforgettable experiences.
Join us if you want to drive global impact, master data-driven creativity, and help millions of people discover their next unforgettable experience.

We're looking for a Growth Analytics Sr analyst to become the analytical backbone of Secret Media Network. You'll own the data infrastructure that the wider team relies on, and you'll use that data to actively find ways to grow the business. This is a hands-on role that mixes data engineering with genuine business analysis, and increasingly, AI-powered automation. You won't just report numbers, you'll help shape decisions with them and build the tools that make that analysis faster.

Data Infrastructure & Reporting
Own and maintain the data pipelines and dashboards that power the team's reporting.
Ensure a single, consistent definition of core metrics across the team, so everyone measures success the same way.
Business Analytics & Experimentation
Design and run experiments to identify what drives better performance - from content formats to on-site features - and turn results into clear recommendations.
Proactively dig into the data to surface growth opportunities the team isn't yet acting on, not just answer questions you're asked.
Translate analysis into business impact
Data Foundations & Governance
Design the data and definitions that the whole team builds on. Not just fixing issues as they appear, but architecting the pipelines so those issues don't happen in the first place.
Set and enforce standards for data quality, documentation, and access, so the team can trust and self-serve the data with confidence.
AI & Automation
Use AI tools to speed up and scale analysis. From automating recurring reports to building AI-assisted workflows that surface insights without manual digging.
Identify opportunities to automate manual data/reporting processes, partnering with the team's automation and tooling function where needed.
Stay current on AI-powered analytics tooling and bring in what's genuinely useful
Cross-Functional Support
Act as the go-to data partner for the different functions across the team, translating their questions into reliable, fast answers.
Present findings in a way that non-technical stakeholders can act on, not just technical ones.

You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or another STEM field.
3-5 years of experience in a Data Analyst / Analytics / Business Intelligence role, ideally in a fast-paced, digital-first environment.
SQL skills and hands-on experience with modern data stacks (dbt or equivalent, cloud data warehouses).
Experience building and maintaining dashboards (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or similar).
Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate or accelerate analytics work
A genuinely curious, business-minded analyst — someone who enjoys asking "why" and "what should we do about it," not just "what happened."
Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests / experiments is a strong plus.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning messy questions into clear analysis.
Proficiency in both written and spoken English is a must; Spanish is a plus.

Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française
Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !
Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonné.e.s, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L'alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.
La France est l'un des plus jeunes marchés du groupe, lancé en 2019, et nous y avons connu une croissance fulgurante nous propulsant comme leader du marché. Rejoindre notre équipe, c'est la garantie d'avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-up françaises les plus prometteuses !
Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.
Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !

L'équipe Marketing Analytics France est une petite équipe au cœur du pilotage de la performance marketing FR. En tant qu'Analyste Marketing, tu reporteras à notre Analytics and Retention Lead, et tu seras un maillon essentiel de notre équipe Growth/Marketing : tu es au cœur de nos décisions et garant.e de la fiabilité des données qui les alimentent.
Ce rôle est central pour faire tourner nos opérations analytiques au quotidien (en gardant le ROI et la CLV au centre de toutes nos décisions marketing), tout en contribuant à la réflexion de plus long terme sur notre stratégie de croissance et nos insights clients.

C'est un poste varié : tu pourras passer une journée à planifier un AB test avec un channel manager, la suivante à contribuer à un exercice de budget, et la troisième à driver l'adoption d'un nouvel outil IA au sein de l'équipe. Tu bénéficieras d'une forte exposition auprès de nombreuses équipes (marketing, produit, opérations, stratégie).

Performance marketing : tu suis notre performance marketing et pilotes nos principaux KPIs. Tu détectes les signaux de performance (court et long terme) et les fais remonter auprès des équipes concernées.
Analyses ad-hoc / Business partner des channel managers : tu es au cœur de nos initiatives growth/marketing. Tu aides les channel managers à construire et analyser leurs tests, pour en tirer les meilleures conclusions possibles. Tu es un vrai partenaire de réflexion pour ces équipes.
Développement et maintenance d'outils analytiques et de process : tu conçois et maintiens des outils analytiques internes (scripts, dashboards, automatisations) pour soutenir les workflows de l'équipe Growth. Par exemple : les reports quotidiens, les meetings hebdo ou le budget bi-annuel.
Analyses stratégiques : tu travailleras sur la définition de notre stratégie de croissance — pénétration géographique et par canal, allocation des investissements marketing, arbitrages entre acquisition et rétention pour éclairer des décisions qui engagent l'entreprise sur plusieurs années, avec une forte exposition au C-level France.
Implémentation IA : tu seras un 'AI champion' pour augmenter l'efficacité de nos process. Tu mettras en place de l'agentic analytics, et accompagneras le reste de l'équipe marketing dans l'automatisation de certains process existants.
Collaboration cross-équipes : tu seras en collaboration étroite avec l'équipe marketing évidemment, mais aussi les équipes finance, produit & opérations (pour comprendre les comportements des clients), et Global Analytics (située à Berlin).

Tu as une grande attention au détail et fais preuve d'une grande rigueur.
Tu as 2 à 4 ans d'expérience en analytics, business intelligence ou performance marketing, idéalement dans un environnement e-commerce, D2C ou fast-paced.
Tu es issu.e d'une formation supérieure (école de commerce, d'ingénieur, ou cursus universitaire) avec une spécialisation data/analytics.
Tu maîtrises Excel/Google Sheets à un niveau avancé, et tu es à l'aise avec des outils de BI (Tableau, Clarisights ou équivalent). Tu maîtrises les principaux outils IA (Claude Cowork/Code). SQL est un vrai plus.
Tu es organisé.e et tu sais prioriser entre des sujets multiples, à la fois opérationnels et stratégiques.
Tu es autonome et proactif.ve : tu identifies les bonnes questions autant que tu y réponds. Tu es force de proposition et agis comme sparring partner pour les équipes avec lesquelles tu travailles, afin de nourrir la réflexion.
Tu parles couramment français et anglais à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
Bonus : tu as une appétence pour le secteur food, retail ou grande consommation.

Un impact réel : tes analyses alimentent directement les décisions de croissance d'une des plus belles scale-ups européennes.
Une équipe bienveillante et une petite team qui t'aidera à monter rapidement en compétence.

About One Acre Fund
Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services.

On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions.

Ohne dich treffen wir Entscheidungen im Bauchgefühl. Mit dir bei entstehen ein Zahlenfundament und eine Perspektive, die beides können: erklären, was war und aufzeigen, was möglich ist. Du hast in der Vergangenheit nicht nur mit Daten gearbeitet, sondern bereits Strukturen aufgebaut, Prozesse etabliert und einen BI-Bereich wirklich geprägt? Dann bring deinen Erfahrungsschatz bei uns ein!

Den Wald sehen, nicht nur die Bäume.
Du liebst es, Zusammenhänge zu erkennen, die andere übersehen. Komplexe Datenlagen schrecken dich nicht ab – du machst sie navigierbar und verständlich. Gleichzeitig weißt du, welche strategisch relevant sind und welche nicht.
Aus wenig viel machen.
Perfekte Datenlage? Die gibt es selten. Du weißt, wie du mit dem arbeitest, was da ist, machst Annahmen transparent und sprichst dennoch klaren Handlungsempfehlungen aus.
Übersetzen statt berichten.
Zahlen allein verändern nichts. Du bringst sie zum Sprechen und schaffst eine Basis für fundierte Entscheidungen. Du hast ein gutes Gespür, welche Daten Geschäftsführung, Finanzen und Product Management brauchen und weißt genau, wie du Komplexität so aufbereitest, dass sie Entscheidungen beschleunigt statt verzögert.
Gestalten, nicht warten.
Du siehst, was fehlt, und fängst an - ohne vollständige Roadmap, ohne perfekte Grundlage. Du hast bereits in einem anderen Kontext BI Strukturen aufgebaut und weißt wo die Fallstricke liegen – dieses Wissen möchtest du bei uns einbringen.

s.h: So bringst du deine Skills ein
s.t:
Dich erwartet eine grüne Wiese: Du baust den BI-Bereich auf – Strukturen, Prozesse, Tooling – und entwickelst ihn iterativ weiter
Du beschleunigst Entscheidungen durch verlässliche Analysen, Prognosen und Handlungsempfehlungen für strategische Planung, Produktmanagement und Finanzen
Du beobachtest neben unserer eigenen Entwicklung auch Markt und Wettbewerb und übersetzt externe Signale in strategische Impulse
Das bieten wir dir
Sicherheit & Perspektive
Unbefristete Verträge, Gleitzeit, ein branchenübliches Gehalt, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und 30 Urlaubstage: Wir suchen coole Leute für eine dauerhafte Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe und wollen gemeinsam mit dir durch dick und dünn gehen.
Deine Entwicklung
Wir wollen, dass du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst. Dabei unterstützen wir dich aktiv durch Weiterbildungen, Schulungen und unser Coaching-Angebot. Du siehst ein spannendes Thema, das dich und uns voranbringt? Dann nimm dir die Zeit, dich damit zu beschäftigen.
Dein Einfluss
Mitdenker gesucht! Wir geben deinen Ideen Raum und sind offen für Neues. So entwickeln wir uns als Unternehmen stetig weiter. Du möchtest was bewegen? Bring dich ein und lass deinen Gedanken freien Raum. Wir leben echte Mitbestimmung - unabhängig von Rolle und Titel.
Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden
Du kannst dich auf Angebote rund um deine körperliche und mentale Gesundheit (wie Sportnavi, aktive Pause, etc.), unser Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits freuen. Natürlich ist bei uns auch für Vitamine, Koffein & H2O gesorgt.

Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im BI- oder Analytics-Umfeld mit – idealerweise hast du bereits Strukturen aufgebaut, nicht nur betrieben
Du arbeitest sicher mindestens einem BI-Tool – bei uns nutzen wir aktuell Qlik; Erfahrung mit Power BI, Tableau oder vergleichbaren Tools ist genauso willkommen
Du setzt KI gezielt als Werkzeug ein – für Analysen, Mustererkennung und Visualisierung – und weißt, wann sie hilft und wann nicht
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse
Ein analytischer Pragmatiker mit Blick fürs große Ganze und dem Mut, bei uns einen neuen Bereich aufzubauen

The Data Analyst will collaborate closely with program staff, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure the accuracy and quality of data while identifying trends and making recommendations for program improvement. Collect, verify, and organize data from a variety of sources, including statistical studies, surveys, and databases.
